fact: The June 2020 oversight policy framework states that the BCC's statutes (art. 9), Law 13-003 and Decree 15-026 give it the oversight mandate for payment systems, that the payments law was still a 2019 draft, and that three non-bank e-money institutions had been approved under Regulation 01/2017.
title: Banque Centrale des Comores: Payment and Settlement Systems Oversight Policy Framework
publisher: World Bank Group (project P170411) for the Banque Centrale des Comores
